{
  "name": "qiongli",
  "version": "2.0.0-beta.1",
  "description": "Dependency-free native academic research workflows for Codex.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Jiaxin Peng",
    "url": "https://github.com/jxpeng98"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/jxpeng98/qiongli",
  "repository": "https://github.com/jxpeng98/qiongli",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "research",
    "academic-writing",
    "literature-review",
    "reproducibility"
  ],
  "skills": "./",
  "interface": {
    "displayName": "Qiongli",
    "shortDescription": "Native academic research workflows for Codex.",
    "longDescription": "Plan, review, write, and audit academic research with the dependency-free Qiongli 2 native workflow.",
    "developerName": "Jiaxin Peng",
    "category": "Education",
    "capabilities": [
      "Read",
      "Write"
    ],
    "websiteURL": "https://github.com/jxpeng98/qiongli",
    "defaultPrompt": [
      "Use $qiongli to plan an academic paper.",
      "Use $qiongli to review a manuscript with claim-evidence checks.",
      "Use $qiongli to audit analysis code for reproducibility."
    ],
    "brandColor": "#2563EB"
  }
}
